user.title: Boiler Room
user.description:
Every key is optional and free. Each one unlocks more entities — you can add or change them later from Reconfigure.

- **Congress.gov** — your members of Congress, their newest bills, and federal bills you follow. [Get a key]({congress_url})
- **Open States** — finds your state and federal legislators from your home location, and tracks state bills. [Get a key]({openstates_url})
- **Google Civic** — official election listings for your state. [Enable the API]({civic_url})
- **Cook Political Report** — Cook's race ratings, toss-up counts and your home races. Uses your own Cook login; your plan needs API access. [About the API]({cook_url})

Prediction markets, news and federal Election Day work with no keys at all.

init.title: What to follow
init.description: Lists take one item per line or comma-separated. Not recognized: {invalid}

data_description.state: Auto works when an Open States key is set. Without it, pick your state for senators from Congress.gov.
data_description.congressional_district: Only needed without an Open States key. Use 0 for at-large states.
data_description.federal_bills: e.g. HR 1234, S.55, 118/hr/815, or a congress.gov bill link. Defaults to the current Congress. Needs a Congress.gov key.
data_description.state_bills: e.g. S1234 or A 5678 for your state, or ny:S1234 for another. Needs an Open States key.
data_description.markets: Paste a polymarket.com event or market link, or just its slug.
data_description.odds_alert_threshold: Fire a boiler_room_odds_moved event when an outcome moves at least this many percentage points between checks. 0 turns it off.
data_description.news_sources: Established outlets with working feeds, picked to span the spectrum.
data_description.custom_feeds: Any RSS or Atom link, one per line — a subreddit's .rss link, your local paper, a Substack.
data_description.news_keywords: Comma-separated. When set, only headlines containing one of these are kept.
data_description.headline_count: How many recent headlines the sensor keeps in its attributes.
